News

Sep 14, 2026 Three short papers from my masters students accepted at AMW 2026 — Together with four of my masters students: Rodrigo Molina, Benito Fuentes, Sebastián Vergara and Valentina Esteban we got three short papers accepted to the 17th Alberto Mendelzon International Workshop on Foundations of Data Management. A nice venue for global top-tier scientific exchange here in Sudamerica. My students will be presenting at the event in Arequipa, Perú in November.
Aug 21, 2026 Short paper accepted at the DMKG Workshop @ ISWC — A shor paper with a proposal spec to update RML to produce RDF 1.2 graphs was accepted to the 2nd International Workshop on Data Management for Knowledge Graphs. Joint work with Julián Arenas-Guerrero, Olaf Hartig, and my masters student Sebastián Vergara.
Aug 6, 2026 My first UChile master's student defended her thesis — Valentina Esteban, co-advised with the wonderful Ivana Bachman, defended her thesis on GNN-based prediction of Autonomous System relationship types, and graduated with the highest mark! Congrats, Valentina.
Aug 4, 2026 ISWC Industry Track paper accepted — Our short article describing Maqui.ai was accepted to the Industry Track of ISWC 2026. Maqui is an IMFD start-up that helps users find and navigate the legal bodies that apply to a given problem by combining a legal knowledge graph with graph-augmented retrieval-augmented generation.
Jul 17, 2026 ISWC paper accepted — Our article froGQL: Worst-Case Optimal Joins and Type-Driven Optimization for Lightweight GQL was accepted to the Resources Track of the 25th International Semantic Web Conference. I will be presenting it in Bari, Italy, in October.
Jun 8, 2026 Fondef IDeA I+D adjudicated — Under the direction of Eduardo Graells, we will be developing Colibrí: a platform for data analysis and visualization for the Municipality of Independencia.
Jun 1, 2026 I'm joining the Department of Computer Science (DCC)! — As of today, I am joining the DCC of Universidad de Chile as an Assistant Professor. This complements my current position at the Data and Artificial Intelligence Initiative of the same university. You can read more here (in Spanish).
Mar 25, 2026 Editorial board member — I was invited to join the Editorial Board of the Semantic Web Journal. I am very honoured!
